safe_auto.instructions: Determine whether the requested action is safe for the System-1 layer to auto-execute without System-2 review.
safe_auto.proposition: The requested action is safe to auto-execute without deeper review.

false.what: Destructive or hard-to-reverse actions, credential/secret handling, or changes that cut across components or behavior
examples: Drop the users table and re-run migrations
Read AWS credentials from .env and put them in the config
Refactor auth to use a new session store

true.what: Read-only or trivially reversible actions with no secrets involved and no behavior visible outside the immediate change
examples: Rename a variable and update its tests
Fix a typo in a log message
